item.text: {"prompt":"A square, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting filling the entire image edge to edge. Express the tension between proliferating possibilities and a small, deliberate commitment through paint alone. A dense, off-center accumulation of midnight blue, bruised violet, and charcoal is worked in translucent veils, scraped impasto, and restless short strokes. Threads of acid yellow and hot vermilion interrupt the dark layers, sometimes buried, sometimes abruptly exposed. Let overlapping gestures compete in direction and tempo, then gradually gather into a few broad, decisive sweeps of pale turquoise. Preserve a large, irregular breathing space of warm ivory, subtly stained by the surrounding colors; its edges should feel negotiated, never neatly bounded. Alternate crowded, granular passages with thin washes and raw, quiet surfaces. Include revisions, partially erased marks, wet pigment dragged through dry ridges, and unexpected pockets of luminous color beneath muted layers. The rhythm should feel searching, recursive, and alert, with restraint holding intense activity in suspension. Maintain asymmetry and spatial tension without a central emblem or readable structure. Everything must remain entirely abstract: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, border, wall, room, or gallery setting; only the painting filling the square."}
